EVENT_GROUP(event_code) (event_code >> 4)

Get event code group definition.

Enums

enum T_EVENT_GROUP

Event group definitions.

Event code is 1 byte code to define messages type exchanging from/to different layers. First half byte is for group define, and second half byte is for code define. Group code: 0: from stack layer 0x1: from peripheral layer 0x2: from audio lib 0xA: from instrument

Values:

enumerator EVENT_GROUP_STACK

message group from BT layer

enumerator EVENT_GROUP_IO

message group from IO layer

enumerator EVENT_GROUP_FRAMEWORK

message group from Framework layer

enumerator EVENT_GROUP_APP

message group from APP layer

enumerator EVENT_GROUP_INSTRUMENT

message group from instrument layer
